decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight was launched only in 2023 and sits close to the firm's core modular lighting systems, and it has its own product page and planning data. Weak early results can still be attributed to the launch phase, and dropping it would write off development and dealer display investments.

The LED ceiling luminaire is a recent launch that fits the firm's established range and is publicly presented on its own page. Management has invested in tooling, technical files and dealer support, and no evidence yet shows that weak results go beyond temporary causes, so it will persist with the product.
